headline: A 2004 executive order sets up a federal Committee on Ocean Policy.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President George W. Bush, creates a Committee on Ocean Policy within the federal government. No summary was provided, so details about the committee's members, duties, and powers are not described here. Based on the title, its main purpose appears to be organizing how the federal government handles ocean policy.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that work on ocean issues
who_it_affects.how: They may take part in or coordinate through the new committee, though the specific requirements are not described in the available material.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on December 17, 2004, though the source material does not state this.
